title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
title_zh: 面向长期法律推理的测试时智能体演化

paragraphs.en: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose TALA , which introduces Test-Time Memory Evolution to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, Rubric-Aligned Collaboration verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 法律智能旨在支持涉及不断变化的案件状态和多重角色的长期法律流程中的可靠决策。 然而，现实中的法律部署在事实、证据和程序背景方面表现出显著的案件异质性，从而暴露了静态智能体策略的局限性。 此外，法律推理在不同角色和程序阶段之间具有内在的相互依赖性，这使得全局可靠性与孤立的角色能力存在根本区别。 为应对这些挑战，我们研究了无需训练的测试时智能体自适应方法，其中智能体能够持续利用部署时来自先前案件和正在进行交互的信号，而无需更新模型参数。 我们提出了 TALA，它引入了测试时记忆演化机制，用于从过往案件中检索可重用的经验，将其适配到当前的事实和程序背景中，并整合积累的经验以支持后续决策。 此外，评分标准对齐协作机制能够根据行为和程序要求验证并修正特定角色的行动，从而实现跨角色和阶段的协同决策。 在 J1-EVAL 和 LegalWorld 上针对五种基础模型开展的广泛实验表明，该方法在合理交互和计算成本的前提下，相较于代表性的推理和智能体基线模型实现了持续的性能提升。 消融研究和案例研究进一步表明，这两个组件在经验自适应和跨角色协调方面提供了互补的优势，提升了长期法律推理的可靠性和效率。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as interactive legal agents for legal question answering, document understanding, and agent-based reasoning ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Enguehard et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . However, real-world legal practice rarely consists of isolated tasks or single-turn interactions. Legal consultation, document drafting, trial, and appeal are often sequentially connected, where facts, evidence, claims, and decisions produced at one stage constrain subsequent stages ( Zuo et al., 2026 ) . Legal agents must therefore maintain and update case states while reasoning coherently across extended interactions. The challenge of legal intelligence is thus shifting from merely knowing the law to acting reliably over time.

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks have begun to capture such long-horizon characteristics through multi-turn interaction, and multi-role legal environments ( Jia et al., 2026 ; Zuo et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, a dynamic environment does not necessarily imply an adaptive agent. Existing agent frameworks typically employ interaction strategies specified before deployment, such as predefined planning, reasoning, and tool-use procedures ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Topsakal and Akinci, 2023 ) . Although agents can react to observations within a trajectory, their underlying interaction strategies often remain largely fixed as deployment conditions evolve across cases, roles, and procedural stages. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), such static deployment strategies may struggle to adapt to newly emerging information and changing procedural contexts, allowing local errors to propagate into inconsistent arguments and faulty claims. This reveals a fundamental gap between increasingly dynamic legal environments and largely predetermined agent strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基准测试已开始通过多轮互动和多角色法律环境来捕捉此类长期特征（Jia 等人，2026；Zuo 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026）。 然而，动态环境并不必然意味着智能体具备适应性。 现有的智能体框架通常在部署前就规定了互动策略，例如预定义的规划、推理和工具使用流程（Yao 等人，2022；Wang 等人，2023；Topsakal 和 Akinci，2023）。 尽管智能体能够根据轨迹中的观察结果做出反应，但其底层的互动策略往往在部署条件随案例、角色和流程阶段变化时仍基本保持不变。 如图 1 (a) 所示，此类静态部署策略可能难以适应新出现的信息和不断变化的流程背景，导致局部错误演变为不一致的论点和错误的结论。 这揭示了日益动态的法律环境与基本预定的智能体策略之间的根本性差距。

paragraphs.en: In realistic deployment, legal cases arrive continuously, making it impractical to fine-tune or reinforce an agent for every newly encountered case ( Cai et al., 2025 ) . A more practical alternative is to exploit signals naturally available during deployment without updating the underlying model. Recent studies have explored memory- and experience-based mechanisms for reusing information accumulated from previous interactions ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ) . However, experience from one case is not directly transferable to another, as even cases involving the same offense may differ substantially in facts, evidence, and procedural context. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (b1), naively reusing prior experience can therefore introduce mismatched or misleading guidance. The first challenge is thus how to reconcile cross-case experience transfer with case-specific adaptation across heterogeneous legal cases.

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, long-horizon legal reasoning is inherently coupled across roles and procedural stages. Existing methods often improve individual legal roles in isolation ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , yet stronger local decisions do not necessarily lead to reliable end-to-end execution. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (b2), decisions made by one role shape the context for subsequent roles, making cross-role misalignment particularly harmful as local inconsistencies can propagate across stages and compromise end-to-end reliability. The second challenge is therefore how to jointly coordinate decisions across coupled legal roles and procedural stages toward globally consistent execution.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，长期法律推理本质上涉及不同角色和程序阶段之间的相互关联。 现有方法通常孤立地改进单个法律角色（Yue et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2026），但更优的局部决策并不必然带来可靠的端到端执行。 如图 1 (b2) 所示，一个角色所做的决策会影响后续角色的上下文，因此跨角色的不一致性尤为有害，因为局部矛盾可能在不同阶段间传播，从而损害端到端的可靠性。 因此，第二个挑战在于如何协同协调相互关联的法律角色和程序阶段的决策，以实现全局一致的执行。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we aim to enable LLM agents to adapt throughout long-horizon legal interactions using signals naturally available during deployment. We propose TALA , a training-free framework that improves agent behavior at test time without updating the underlying model parameters. To handle case heterogeneity, TALA introduces Test-Time Memory Evolution (TME) , which retrieves relevant experience from preceding cases, adapts it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidates accumulated experience under a bounded memory budget. This allows prior interactions to provide reusable guidance without directly transferring case-specific facts or evidence. To mitigate cross-role misalignment, we further introduce Rubric-Aligned Collaboration (RAC) , which verifies and revises each role’s actions according to role-specific behavioral and procedural requirements, preventing locally plausible decisions from introducing inconsistencies into subsequent roles and stages. Together, these mechanisms enable TALA to evolve both cross-case experience and cross-role decision-making throughout continual legal deployment, improving the global reliability of long-horizon interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们的目标是让大型语言模型智能体能够在长期法律互动中持续适应，并利用部署过程中自然存在的信号实现这一目标。 我们提出了 TALA——一个无需训练的框架，它能在测试时提升智能体的行为表现，而无需更新底层模型参数。 为处理案件异质性，TALA 引入了测试时记忆演化（TME）机制：该机制从过往案件中检索相关经验，将其适配到当前的事实与程序背景中，并在有限的记忆预算下整合积累的经验。 这使得先前的互动能够提供可重复使用的指导，而无需直接转移特定案件的事实或证据。 为缓解跨角色不一致问题，我们进一步引入了评分标准对齐协作（RAC）机制：该机制根据各角色的特定行为与程序要求，验证并修正每个角色的行动，防止局部看似合理的决策在后续角色和阶段中引发矛盾。 这些机制共同使 TALA 能够在持续的法律部署过程中，同时演化跨案件经验和跨角色决策能力，从而提升长期互动的整体可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld demonstrate that TALA consistently improves performance across five backbone models and diverse long-horizon legal scenarios, showing strong generalization across model families and scales. paragraphs.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows. (1) We formulate long-horizon legal reasoning from a deployment-time evolution perspective, highlighting two fundamental challenges that arise under continual legal deployment: case heterogeneity , which complicates cross-case experience transfer, and cross-role misalignment , which makes local decisions consequential for subsequent roles and stages. (2) We propose TALA , a training-free framework for continual test-time agent evolution. It combines TME for context-aware cross-case experience adaptation with RAC for coordinated decision-making across coupled legal roles and procedural stages. (3) Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent gains across model families and scales, improved robustness in long-horizon execution, and moderate test-time overhead.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based Legal Agents . Early studies on legal LLMs mainly focus on static legal capabilities, such as legal knowledge acquisition, judgment prediction, and document understanding, through benchmark construction and domain-specific adaptation ( Fei et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2023 ; Fei et al., 2025 ; Colombo et al., 2024 ) . More recently, research has shifted toward LLM-based legal agents that support interaction, tool use, and multi-role collaboration in complex legal environments ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . Existing methods further enhance legal agents through predefined reasoning workflows and legal-specific tools ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , or additional training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning ( Cai et al., 2025 ) . However, these improvements are largely determined before deployment, while many case-specific facts, procedural states, role interactions, and tool feedback only emerge during execution. How to exploit such deployment-time signals to continuously adapt subsequent agent behavior remains underexplored. In this paper, we aim to develop self-improving legal agents for more reliable reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Test-Time Adaptation . Test-time adaptation aims to improve model performance during inference without accessing the original training data ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . A prominent line of inference-time improvement is test-time scaling, which allocates additional computation through repeated sampling, majority voting, self-consistency, or iterative refinement ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Snell et al., 2025 ) . While effective for short-form reasoning, such strategies become increasingly costly in long-horizon tasks, where a single trajectory may involve numerous interaction turns, role transitions, and tool calls ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . More fundamentally, long-horizon agent interaction is inherently non-stationary: each action may alter subsequent states, available information, and behavioral constraints, making future decisions dependent on earlier interactions. Consequently, both useful experience and local errors can persist and compound over time. However, existing test-time methods have largely focused on isolated reasoning instances, leaving continual adaptation under interaction-induced non-stationarity relatively underexplored. This paper aims to bridge this gap through test-time agent evolution in long-horizon interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时自适应。 测试时自适应旨在提升模型在推理阶段的性能，而无需访问原始训练数据（Chen 等人，2026）。 一种重要的推理时优化方法是测试时扩展，它通过重复采样、多数投票、自洽性或迭代优化来分配额外的计算资源（Wang 等人，2022；Madaan 等人，2023；Snell 等人，2025）。 尽管这些策略对短形式推理有效，但在长时程任务中，其成本会越来越高，因为单个轨迹可能涉及大量交互轮次、角色转换和工具调用（Huang 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2026）。 更根本的是，长时程智能体交互本质上是非平稳的：每个动作都可能改变后续状态、可用信息和行为约束，导致未来的决策依赖于早期的交互。 因此，既有有用的经验，也可能存在局部错误，且二者都会随时间持续累积。 然而，现有的测试时方法大多集中在孤立的推理实例上，而交互引发的非平稳性下的持续自适应问题则相对未被充分研究。 本文旨在通过长时程交互中的测试时智能体演化来填补这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Real-world legal tasks involve complex, multi-stage decision-making ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , often requiring external legal knowledge and specialized tools. However, existing LLM agents remain unreliable in tool use and long-horizon interactions ( Patil et al., 2025 ) . To address this, we propose a Test-Time Memory Evolution (TME) mechanism that continuously accumulates and refines interaction experience during inference to support subsequent decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的法律任务涉及复杂的多阶段决策（Liu 等人，2026），通常需要外部法律知识和专业工具。 然而，现有的 LLM 智能体在工具使用和长期交互方面仍然不可靠（Patil 等人，2025）。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种测试时记忆演化（TME）机制，该机制在推理过程中持续积累并优化交互经验，以支持后续的决策。

paragraphs.en: J1-EVAL ( Jia et al., 2026 ) contains six interactive legal scenarios covering different stages and roles in legal practice: Knowledge Questioning (KQ), Legal Consultation (LC), Complaint Drafting (CD), Defence Drafting (DD), Civil Court (CI), and Criminal Court (CR). Beyond static legal question answering, these tasks require agents to interact with simulated users or legal participants over multiple turns, progressively collect case-relevant information, generate legal documents, and follow scenario-specific procedures. The benchmark therefore evaluates both legal reasoning and the agent’s ability to maintain coherent behavior throughout multi-turn interactions.
paragraphs.zh: J1-EVAL（Jia 等人，2026）包含六个互动式法律场景，涵盖了法律实践中的不同阶段和角色：知识问答（KQ）、法律咨询（LC）、投诉起草（CD）、辩护起草（DD）、民事法庭（CI）和刑事法庭（CR）。 除了静态的法律问答之外，这些任务还要求智能体与模拟用户或法律参与者进行多轮互动，逐步收集与案件相关的信息、生成法律文件，并遵循特定场景的流程。 因此，该基准既评估法律推理能力，也评估智能体在整个多轮互动中保持连贯行为的能力。

paragraphs.en: LegalWorld ( Zuo et al., 2026 ) simulates a long-horizon civil litigation process through seven interconnected stages: Legal Consultation (LC), Complaint Drafting (CD), Defence Drafting (DD), First-Instance Trial (FIT), Appeal Drafting (AD), Appeal Response (AR), and Second-Instance Trial (SIT). In contrast to independently evaluated scenarios, the outputs and case states produced in earlier stages are carried forward to subsequent stages, forming a continuous litigation trajectory. This setting evaluates whether legal agents can preserve and utilize long-term case information, adapt to evolving procedural states, and maintain consistent reasoning across different stages of litigation.
paragraphs.zh: LegalWorld（Zuo 等人，2026）通过七个相互关联的阶段模拟了一个长期民事诉讼过程：法律咨询（LC）、起诉状起草（CD）、答辩状起草（DD）、一审审判（FIT）、上诉状起草（AD）、上诉回应（AR）和二审审判（SIT）。 与独立评估的场景不同，早期阶段产生的输出和案件状态会被带入后续阶段，从而形成一条连续的诉讼轨迹。 这一设置旨在评估法律智能体是否能够保留并利用长期案件信息，适应不断变化的程序状态，并在诉讼的不同阶段保持推理的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Baselines . We compare our method with several representative reasoning and agent baselines. SourceOnly directly uses the original backbone model without additional design. We consider five representative open-source LLMs from three model families: GLM-4-9B ( Glm et al., 2024 ) , InternLM3-8B ( Cai et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, and Qwen3.5-4B ( Team, 2025 ) . These models cover different model scales and serve as the base models for evaluating the effectiveness and generalizability of different agent frameworks. ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) interleaves reasoning and action generation, allowing the agent to iteratively interact with external tools and update its reasoning based on environmental observations. Plan-and-Solve ( Wang et al., 2023 ) first decomposes a complex task into a sequence of manageable subtasks and then solves them sequentially according to the generated plan. Plan-and-Execute ( Topsakal and Akinci, 2023 ) further separates high-level planning from step-wise execution, where a planner generates a global task plan and an executor carries out individual steps with available tools. LawThinker ( Yang et al., 2026 ) is a legal-specific agent based on an Explore–Verify–Memorize workflow, which retrieves legal knowledge, explicitly verifies intermediate evidence and reasoning, and stores validated information for reuse in subsequent interactions. For a fair comparison, all methods are instantiated with the same backbone models and evaluation settings, and agent-based baselines are provided with the same set of external tools.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们将我们的方法与几种具有代表性的推理和智能体基线方法进行比较。 SourceOnly 直接使用原始骨干模型，无需额外设计。 我们考虑了来自三个模型家族的五个代表性开源大型语言模型：GLM-4-9B（Glm 等人，2024）、InternLM3-8B（Cai 等人，2024）、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B 和 Qwen3.5-4B（Team，2025）。 这些模型涵盖了不同的模型规模，并用作评估不同智能体框架有效性和泛化能力的基线模型。 ReAct（Yao 等人，2022）交替进行推理和行动生成，使智能体能够迭代地与外部工具交互，并根据环境观察更新其推理过程。 Plan-and-Solve（Wang 等人，2023）首先将复杂任务分解为一系列可管理的子任务，然后按照生成的计划依次解决这些子任务。 Plan-and-Execute（Topsakal 和 Akinci，2023）进一步将高层规划与分步执行分离开来：规划器生成全局任务计划，而执行器则利用可用工具完成各个步骤。 LawThinker（Yang 等人，2026）是一种基于“探索–验证–记忆”工作流的法律专用智能体，它能检索法律知识、明确验证中间证据和推理过程，并将经过验证的信息存储起来以便在后续交互中重复使用。 为确保公平比较，所有方法均使用相同的骨干模型和评估设置进行实现，且基于智能体的基线方法也配备了相同的外部工具集。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , removing either component consistently degrades the performance of TALA across all five backbone models and both benchmarks. On J1-EVAL, removing Test-Time Memory Evolution leads to an average performance drop of 17.5 points, while removing Rubric-Aligned Collaboration results in a 15.3-point drop. Similar trends are observed on LegalWorld, with average decreases of 13.0 and 9.4 points after removing TME and RAC, respectively. Averaged over all model–benchmark combinations, the performance drops are 15.2 points for w/o TME and 12.4 points for w/o RAC. paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 further illustrates how the two components of TALA affect agent behavior through representative cases. In the J1-EVAL consultation case, the user raises multiple legal issues concerning the validity of prior civil acts, applicable provisions, liquidation, and company termination. SourceOnly provides only a partial response and terminates the conversation before the remaining issues are addressed. paragraphs.en: The LegalWorld case demonstrates a different failure mode in a long-horizon, multi-stage legal workflow. The same dispute evolves from consultation and complaint drafting to first-instance and appellate proceedings, requiring the agent to preserve case evidence while adapting to changing role objectives. SourceOnly exhibits advocacy drift: although acting as the respondent’s lawyer, it focuses on defending the rejection of its own claimed shipping loss rather than protecting the favorable RMB 80,000 judgment. Test-Time Memory Evolution successfully recovers prior-stage evidence, including the payment and receipt information, but the advocacy objective can still remain misaligned. Rubric-Aligned Collaboration instead regulates stage- and role-specific behavior, such as requiring missing facts to be clarified before drafting, but cannot recover evidence that is unavailable in the current interaction. With both components, TALA preserves relevant evidence across stages while maintaining role-aligned advocacy.

paragraphs.en: We further audit the self-judgment mechanisms in TALA using Jev 1 1 1 https://typesafe.ai/ , an independent lightweight structured judge. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we investigate test-time evolution for long-horizon legal agents and identify two key challenges in realistic deployment: case heterogeneity , which complicates experience transfer across continuously arriving cases, and cross-role coupling , where local decisions can influence subsequent roles and propagate across procedural stages. To address these challenges, we propose TALA , which enables agents to continually adapt throughout deployment by evolving cross-case experience and coordinating decisions across coupled legal roles and stages. Specifically, Test-Time Memory Evolution retrieves, adapts, and consolidates prior interaction experience to support heterogeneous cases, while Rubric-Aligned Collaboration aligns role decisions with behavioral and procedural requirements to improve global consistency across long-horizon interactions. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements across model families and scales, together with stronger robustness in multi-stage execution. Further ablation, efficiency, and case studies show that the two components are complementary and mutually reinforcing, jointly improving cross-case adaptation, cross-role coordination, and the overall reliability of long-horizon legal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了长期法律智能体在测试时的演化过程，并识别出实际部署中的两个关键挑战：案例异质性（case heterogeneity），它使得持续涌入的新案例之间难以实现经验迁移；以及跨角色耦合（cross-role coupling），即局部决策可能影响后续角色，并在程序阶段中传播。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 TALA，该方案使智能体能够在部署过程中持续适应，通过演化跨案例经验，并协调耦合的法律角色与阶段之间的决策。 具体而言，“测试时记忆演化”（Test-Time Memory Evolution）会检索、调整并整合过往的交互经验以支持异质性案例；而“评分标准对齐协作”（Rubric-Aligned Collaboration）则使角色决策与行为及程序要求保持一致，从而提升长期交互中的全局一致性。 在 J1-EVAL 和 LegalWorld 上针对五种基础模型进行的广泛实验表明，该方法在不同模型家族和规模下均表现出一致的性能提升，并在多阶段执行中展现出更强的鲁棒性。 进一步的消融分析、效率评估和案例研究显示，这两个组件具有互补性和相互增强作用，共同提升了跨案例适应能力、跨角色协调性以及长期法律推理的整体可靠性。

sents.en: In this paper, we investigate test-time evolution for long-horizon legal agents and identify two key challenges in realistic deployment: case heterogeneity , which complicates experience transfer across continuously arriving cases, and cross-role coupling , where local decisions can influence subsequent roles and propagate across procedural stages.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了长期法律智能体在测试时的演化过程，并识别出实际部署中的两个关键挑战：案例异质性（case heterogeneity），它使得持续涌入的新案例之间难以实现经验迁移；以及跨角色耦合（cross-role coupling），即局部决策可能影响后续角色，并在程序阶段中传播。

sents.en: To address these challenges, we propose TALA , which enables agents to continually adapt throughout deployment by evolving cross-case experience and coordinating decisions across coupled legal roles and stages.
sents.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 TALA，该方案使智能体能够在部署过程中持续适应，通过演化跨案例经验，并协调耦合的法律角色与阶段之间的决策。

sents.en: Specifically, Test-Time Memory Evolution retrieves, adapts, and consolidates prior interaction experience to support heterogeneous cases, while Rubric-Aligned Collaboration aligns role decisions with behavioral and procedural requirements to improve global consistency across long-horizon interactions.
sents.zh: 具体而言，“测试时记忆演化”（Test-Time Memory Evolution）会检索、调整并整合过往的交互经验以支持异质性案例；而“评分标准对齐协作”（Rubric-Aligned Collaboration）则使角色决策与行为及程序要求保持一致，从而提升长期交互中的全局一致性。

sents.en: Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements across model families and scales, together with stronger robustness in multi-stage execution.
sents.zh: 在 J1-EVAL 和 LegalWorld 上针对五种基础模型进行的广泛实验表明，该方法在不同模型家族和规模下均表现出一致的性能提升，并在多阶段执行中展现出更强的鲁棒性。

sents.en: Further ablation, efficiency, and case studies show that the two components are complementary and mutually reinforcing, jointly improving cross-case adaptation, cross-role coordination, and the overall reliability of long-horizon legal reasoning.
sents.zh: 进一步的消融分析、效率评估和案例研究显示，这两个组件具有互补性和相互增强作用，共同提升了跨案例适应能力、跨角色协调性以及长期法律推理的整体可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our current study focuses on autonomous test-time evolution, while real-world legal decision-making is inherently interactive and often requires sustained collaboration between agents and human professionals. Future work may extend TALA toward human-in-the-loop and recursively interactive legal agents that continuously incorporate expert feedback, user corrections, and procedural changes during deployment. Evaluating such systems in more specialized legal settings, with stronger requirements on accountability, professional expertise, and human-agent coordination, remains an important direction.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 我们当前的研究聚焦于测试时的自主演化，而现实世界中的法律决策本质上具有互动性，通常需要智能体与人类专业人士之间持续的合作。 未来的工作可能会将 TALA 扩展至“人在回路”以及递归互动的法律智能体，使其在部署过程中能够持续整合专家反馈、用户修正和流程变更。 在更具专业性的法律场景下评估此类系统——这些场景对问责制、专业知识和人机协作提出了更高要求——仍然是一个重要的研究方向。

sents.en: Limitations.
sents.zh: 局限性。

sents.en: Our current study focuses on autonomous test-time evolution, while real-world legal decision-making is inherently interactive and often requires sustained collaboration between agents and human professionals.
sents.zh: 我们当前的研究聚焦于测试时的自主演化，而现实世界中的法律决策本质上具有互动性，通常需要智能体与人类专业人士之间持续的合作。

sents.en: Future work may extend TALA toward human-in-the-loop and recursively interactive legal agents that continuously incorporate expert feedback, user corrections, and procedural changes during deployment.
sents.zh: 未来的工作可能会将 TALA 扩展至“人在回路”以及递归互动的法律智能体，使其在部署过程中能够持续整合专家反馈、用户修正和流程变更。

sents.en: Evaluating such systems in more specialized legal settings, with stronger requirements on accountability, professional expertise, and human-agent coordination, remains an important direction.
sents.zh: 在更具专业性的法律场景下评估此类系统——这些场景对问责制、专业知识和人机协作提出了更高要求——仍然是一个重要的研究方向。
